boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Grove City College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Grove City destinations with verified access at 10 p.m. or later, including campus study stops, self-checkout markets, and nearby food runs.

cards.title: The Garage Café
cards.subtitle: Late-night campus café in MAP
cards.notes: Head to MAP for pizza, snacks, ice cream, or coffee; check the dining site before leaving because Friday service is closed.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus evening food counter scheduled through 11 p.m. on most operating nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College lists The Garage Café in MAP and gives closing times of 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Saturday, plus 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current college-posted hours: Monday–Thursday 8–11 p.m.; Saturday 5–11 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; closed Friday. Campus access rules may apply.

cards.title: Hicks Market After Hours
cards.subtitle: A 24/7 self-checkout market in Hicks
cards.notes: Bring your Crimson Card or payment method and use the self-checkout setup when staffed dining counters have already closed.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock campus market suited to a quick packaged-food stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College states that Hicks Market operates 24/7 with self-checkout.
cards.access_notes: The college currently lists Hicks Market as open 24/7 with self-checkout; building and campus-entry rules may still govern access.

cards.title: MAP Market After Hours
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock self-checkout beside MAP Café
cards.notes: Use this stop for packaged food or drinks after MAP Café closes, and confirm residence-area access before making a very late trip.
cards.short_summary: A second 24-hour campus market, located outside the MAP dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies MAP Market as a retail market and lists it as open 24/7 with self-checkout.
cards.access_notes: The college currently lists MAP Market as open 24/7 with self-checkout; campus and building access restrictions may apply.

cards.title: Henry Buhl Library
cards.subtitle: Campus study destination open past midnight
cards.notes: Choose a quiet or group-study area and finish before the posted 1 a.m. close; verify academic-break hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A late study run with 1 a.m. closing times on several school-week nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The college’s Buhl Library page lists office hours until 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 2 p.m.–1 a.m.; verify break schedules.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Main
cards.subtitle: A Grove City drive-through open after midnight
cards.notes: Check the live location page before leaving and plan on the drive-through if the dining room has a different late-night schedule.
cards.short_summary: The latest verified restaurant close in this set, with drive-through service to 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Grove City location page lists the 1560 W. Main Street drive-through as open until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Grove City, PA — 1560 W. Main Street
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists drive-through hours of 9 a.m.–1 a.m. every day; dine-in availability may differ.

cards.title: Domino's on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Downtown carryout and delivery until midnight
cards.notes: Place the order before the posted cutoff and confirm whether carryout or delivery remains available for your campus address.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter with an official midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies its Grove City store at 150 South Broad Street and shows it open until 12 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 150 South Broad Street
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently shows service until 12 a.m.; hours and the availability of delivery versus carryout can vary by day.

cards.title: McDonald's by the Outlets
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-through service to 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Allow time for the trip west of campus and check the location page before departure, especially around holidays or severe weather.
cards.short_summary: A consistently scheduled 11 p.m. option near the Grove City Premium Outlets area.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page lists both restaurant/lobby and drive-through hours through 11 p.m. daily at 1902 Leesburg Grove City Road.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 1902 Leesburg Grove City Road
cards.access_notes: Officially posted restaurant, lobby, and drive-through hours are 5 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Wendy's on Leesburg Grove City Road
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-through through 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the official listing to recheck holiday hours, then choose dine-in, carryout, delivery, or drive-through based on current availability.
cards.short_summary: An outlet-area food run with four listed service modes and an 11 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Grove City page lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Grove City at 1925 Leesburg/Grove City Road
cards.access_notes: The official listing currently gives restaurant and drive-through hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on West Main
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday service to 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday if you need the 11 p.m. window, and distinguish restaurant, carryout, and delivery cutoffs.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-focused late pizza stop whose hours vary by service channel.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official Grove City page lists restaurant and carryout hours until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday at 715 W. Main Street.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut at 715 W Main St
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and carryout are posted until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; dine-in and delivery hours differ.

cards.title: Sheetz on Mercer Butler Pike
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour convenience-food stop west of town
cards.notes: Treat this as a driving run, use the mapped 1931 Mercer Butler Pike location, and verify food-ordering availability upon arrival.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open convenience-store destination for a flexible overnight run.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps identifies the Sheetz at 1931 Mercer Butler Pike in Grove City and lists it as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: The current map listing shows this location open 24 hours every day; overnight food-counter selections or services may vary.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten campus places where Grove City College students can study, collaborate, gather, create, exercise, worship, and find practical support.

cards.title: Settle In Beyond the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Research help, writing support, and flexible study space
cards.notes: Bring a research question to the help desk, meet a writing tutor, or choose between collaborative areas and quieter study space.
cards.short_summary: A renovated academic hub that supports solo work, collaboration, research, and writing.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Henry Buhl Library as its information and study center, with research assistance, a Writing Center, and areas for students to study and collaborate.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed academic-year hours are Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 2 p.m.–1 a.m.; schedules may change during breaks.

cards.title: Use the Union as a Campus Base
cards.subtitle: Lounges, meeting rooms, mail, and student-life services
cards.notes: Check organization tables, meet friends in a lounge, pick up campus mail, or reserve a fishbowl room when focused group work is needed.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock academic-year hub combining everyday errands with gathering and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The official facility page says Breen Student Union contains student lounges, meeting places, commuter facilities, the mailroom, and Student Life offices, with spaces for studying, eating, and events.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week while classes are in session; individual offices, retail services, and reservable rooms follow separate schedules and rules.

cards.entity_name: Staley Hall of Arts and Letters
cards.title: Find a Nook in Staley
cards.subtitle: Open study areas inside an arts-and-letters building
cards.notes: Use the open areas or study nooks for individual work, then shift to a shared space when a class project calls for conversation.
cards.short_summary: An academic building deliberately equipped with nooks and open areas for study and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College states that Staley Hall has numerous open spaces and nooks for studying or group work, plus faculty suites that provide added daytime study space.
cards.source_title: Staley Hall of Arts and Letters
cards.access_notes: The main door has published weekly hours, including late access Monday–Thursday and Sunday; some entrances, floors, and Saturday access have shorter hours or require a campus card.

cards.title: Work Problems Out on the Walls
cards.subtitle: Collaborative study areas with writable surfaces
cards.notes: Bring markers and use designated writable walls to sketch equations or project ideas; shared-monitor stations support laptop-based teamwork.
cards.short_summary: A science building whose common areas and writable surfaces are designed for visible collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: The official STEM Hall page documents common areas and student study spaces, writable Walltalker surfaces, and computer stations where several students can share one monitor.
cards.access_notes: Published building hours are weekdays, with campus-card access Monday–Thursday evenings and Sunday evenings through the doors facing Breen Student Union.

cards.title: Build a Recreation Break Into the Day
cards.subtitle: Indoor fitness, track, courts, pools, and bowling
cards.notes: Fit movement between classes by choosing the indoor track, fitness center, recreation pool, racquetball courts, or another available facility.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use athletics complex that also gives students varied options for everyday recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College says students use the Physical Learning Center for fitness and recreation, including an indoor track, fitness center, pools, racquetball courts, and bowling alley.
cards.access_notes: Student access and the availability of pools, courts, fitness areas, and other components may depend on posted facility schedules, team use, classes, or events.

cards.title: Follow Student Work Into the Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Gallery, rehearsal, production, and performance spaces
cards.notes: Check the campus arts calendar, visit the gallery during an exhibition, or locate the recital and theatre spaces used for student performances.
cards.short_summary: A working arts complex where student exhibitions, recitals, rehearsals, and productions take shape.
cards.evidence_claim: The College documents an art gallery with student and guest exhibitions, student recital venues, rehearsal rooms, production studios, and theatre spaces in Pew Fine Arts Center.
cards.source_title: History Tour | Pew Fine Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Gallery, performance, rehearsal, and studio access varies by class, production, exhibition, and event schedule; specialized work areas may be restricted.

cards.entity_name: Weir C. Ketler Technological Learning Center
cards.title: Use the Walk-Up Technology
cards.subtitle: Computers, training rooms, media studios, and IT support
cards.notes: Use a walk-up computer or seek technical support here; arrange access before planning work in the video or radio production studios.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused building for computer access, instruction, production, and campus technical services.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College says the Ketler Technological Learning Center provides walk-up computers, training rooms, a lecture hall, video and radio studios, and IT service units.
cards.access_notes: Open access is listed until 5 p.m. on weekdays, followed by campus-card access; evening and weekend card-access hours vary by day, and studios may require authorization.

cards.title: Gather Beyond the Main Chapel
cards.subtitle: Student lounge, prayer room, meetings, and campus ministry
cards.notes: Use the student lounge or prayer room between commitments, and coordinate with campus staff before planning a group meeting or special event.
cards.short_summary: A campus-ministry hub with smaller spaces for reflection, conversation, and organized gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The official facility page identifies Rathburn Hall as a spiritual-activities hub available to campus groups, with a student lounge, prayer room, meeting rooms, and lecture space.
cards.access_notes: Published hours extend to 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday, close earlier Friday, and limit Saturday opening to approved scheduled events; room reservations may be required.

cards.title: Make Room for Quiet Reflection
cards.subtitle: Worship, prayer, lectures, music, and community gatherings
cards.notes: Step inside for quiet meditation when access permits, or use the chapel schedule to attend worship, a lecture, or a student-led program.
cards.short_summary: The campus chapel serves both contemplative use and large shared moments of worship and learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College describes Harbison Chapel as a place for worship and quiet meditation and documents its use for prayer, lectures, music, and community gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on worship services, rehearsals, lectures, and other scheduled programs; consult the current chapel schedule before planning a visit.

cards.title: Spread Out in the Lobby Study Space
cards.subtitle: Tables, whiteboards, and a collaborative engineering setting
cards.notes: Take a small engineering problem set to the first-floor lobby, where tables and dry-erase boards support side-by-side collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A practical lobby workspace equipped for engineering students to compare ideas and work through problems.
cards.evidence_claim: The College reports that Hoyt Hall’s first-floor lobby-study space was furnished with tables, chairs, dry-erase boards, and a monitor specifically to support collaborative work.
cards.source_title: Engineering aesthetics: Hoyt Hall gets a makeover
cards.access_notes: Hoyt Hall is an academic building; access follows current campus building policies, and classrooms or specialized engineering areas may be restricted.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, under-21-safe arts outings documented by Grove City College as requiring no admission or purchase. Confirm the next scheduled edition before visiting.

cards.title: Catch an Orchesis Dance Show
cards.subtitle: Student dance in the Physical Learning Center Arena
cards.notes: Bring friends to a scheduled Orchesis performance, and use the official Family Weekend page to confirm the next showtime.
cards.short_summary: A student-led dance program spanning multiple styles and staged as a free public performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that its 2026 Family Weekend concerts and performances were free and open to the public and specifically identified Orchesis as free and public.
cards.access_notes: The documented 2026 performances occurred April 23–25 in the Physical Learning Center Arena; confirm the next scheduled edition before going.

cards.title: Hear the College Bands Together
cards.subtitle: Symphonic Concert Band and Wind Ensemble in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Meet at Pew Fine Arts Center for the paired band program, checking the College music calendar before choosing a date.
cards.short_summary: Two Grove City ensembles share one public concert program featuring wind-band repertoire.
cards.evidence_claim: The College included the 2026 “Joy in All Things” Symphonic Concert Band and Wind Ensemble concert among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert was held April 24, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; consult the current music calendar for a future performance.

cards.title: Browse the Student Art Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Rotating artwork inside Pew Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Walk the gallery with a friend and compare favorite pieces; check the exhibit notice first because displays and hours rotate.
cards.short_summary: A quiet gallery hang centered on work by Grove City students and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies the Pew Fine Arts Center Gallery as a venue for rotating exhibitions, and its official gallery coverage states that the gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: ‘Meet the Fleet’ brings HopeCAT artists to campus
cards.access_notes: Public gallery access is free; exhibition dates and opening hours vary, so verify the current listing before visiting.

cards.title: Watch a Set of One-Act Plays
cards.subtitle: Short student productions in the Little Theatre
cards.notes: Choose one of the listed performances and arrive together at the Little Theatre; verify the next festival schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A compact theater outing featuring several student-produced short plays in one program.
cards.evidence_claim: The College listed Alpha Psi Omega’s 2026 One-Act show among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented performances occurred April 24–25, 2026, in the Little Theatre; confirm future dates through the College calendar.

cards.entity_name: Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band Concert
cards.title: Settle In for Student Jazz
cards.subtitle: Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Gather a group for the full ensemble-and-combo program, then check the official listing for the next public concert date.
cards.short_summary: A live jazz hang pairing the College’s larger ensemble with its seven-piece Stage Band.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College included the 2026 Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band concert among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred April 25, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; verify the next concert on the College music calendar.

cards.title: Cheer Through All-College Sing
cards.subtitle: Campus groups perform in a friendly song-and-dance competition
cards.notes: Go with classmates to support the performing groups, and consult the Family Weekend schedule for the next event time.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific showcase where campus organizations combine singing, movement, and friendly competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College listed the 2026 All-College Sing among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented event occurred April 25, 2026, in the Physical Learning Center Arena; verify the next Family Weekend schedule.

cards.title: Listen to the Revelation Ringers
cards.subtitle: Grove City student handbell choir at Tower Presbyterian Church
cards.notes: Walk into town with friends for the handbell program, checking the College listing for the choir’s next public appearance.
cards.short_summary: A student handbell performance offering a different sound from the College’s band and choir concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identified the Revelation Ringers concert as part of its 2026 Family Weekend slate of concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred April 26, 2026, at Tower Presbyterian Church; confirm the next public performance before going.

cards.title: Hear Two Choirs Perform Haydn
cards.subtitle: Concert Choir and Touring Choir in Harbison Chapel
cards.notes: Meet at Harbison Chapel for the combined-choir program, and verify the next concert date through the music calendar.
cards.short_summary: A large choral outing combining two College choirs with organ accompaniment in the campus chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College included the combined Concert Choir and Touring Choir performance of Haydn’s “Creation” in its 2026 Family Weekend slate, whose concerts and performances were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented performance occurred April 26, 2026, in Harbison Chapel; consult the current calendar for another public concert.

cards.entity_name: Symphony and Chamber Orchestras Spring Concert
cards.title: Share an Orchestra Night
cards.subtitle: Two College orchestras in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Claim seats together for the paired orchestra program, using the official music notice to confirm the next performance.
cards.short_summary: A full evening of orchestral music featuring both Grove City’s Symphony and Chamber Orchestras.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that the March 27, 2026, Symphony and Chamber Orchestras concert was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Concert features Symphony and Chamber orchestras
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred March 27, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; verify the orchestras’ next public concert date.

cards.title: Welcome the Touring Choir Home
cards.subtitle: Tour repertoire performed in Harbison Chapel
cards.notes: Bring a friend to hear the choir’s road program at home, checking the official calendar for its next chapel concert.
cards.short_summary: A home-campus choral performance presenting repertoire prepared for the Touring Choir’s regional trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that the Touring Choir’s March 14, 2026, home concert in Harbison Chapel was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Touring Choir brings its road songs home to Harbison
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred March 14, 2026, in Harbison Chapel; check the current music calendar for the next edition.

warnings: The directly documented 2026 performances have already occurred as of the fetch date. Each card therefore directs readers to confirm the next scheduled edition rather than implying current availability.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Grove City College study settings, from reservable library rooms and quiet reading areas to collaborative academic-building lounges.

cards.title: Spread Out in the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Flexible solo and group study inside Henry Buhl Library
cards.notes: Bring a device and choose movable furniture for solo work or collaboration; use the nearby outlets and keep extended conversation elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A flexible library workspace with movable seating, plentiful power, and adjoining technology-equipped huddle rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies the Mehaffey Learning Commons as a versatile study area with movable furniture, outlets, and huddle rooms equipped for collaboration.
cards.source_title: College rededicates library after $9 million renovation
cards.access_notes: Inside Buhl Library. Current posted semester hours are Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday 2 p.m.–1 a.m. The College designates the Learning Commons for group study.

cards.title: Settle into the Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Study tables and alcoves on Buhl Library’s ground floor
cards.notes: Choose a table or alcove for focused reading, and visit the reference desk in the room when a source or citation question stalls your work.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor reading and reference room suited to quieter, research-heavy sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The renovated Gasiewicz Reading Room contains the library reference desk, study tables, and alcoves on Buhl Library’s ground floor.
cards.source_title: College rededicates library after $9 million renovation
cards.access_notes: Inside Buhl Library during posted library hours. The College reserves the lower-level reference area for quiet study; phone calls are limited to designated areas.

cards.title: Book the Allen Study Room
cards.subtitle: A named private study room in Henry Buhl Library
cards.notes: Reserve the room online before meeting, arrive with materials ready, and leave meals outside; library rules prohibit all food in study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A named enclosed library room for a planned private or small-group work session.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College lists Allen Study Room among Henry Buhl Library’s named spaces; the library provides reservable quiet and private study rooms.
cards.source_title: College rededicates library after $9 million renovation
cards.access_notes: Inside Buhl Library. Study rooms use the library’s online reservation system. No food is permitted in study rooms; consult the current library schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a Quiet Room Session
cards.subtitle: Reservable enclosed space inside Henry Buhl Library
cards.notes: Use the online reservation system for a distraction-limited session, keep drinks lidded, and move phone calls to a designated calling area.
cards.short_summary: A named private room that trades open-floor flexibility for a more contained study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Hefren-Tillotson Study Room as a named space in the renovated Henry Buhl Library, where private study rooms are available.
cards.source_title: College rededicates library after $9 million renovation
cards.access_notes: Inside Buhl Library and subject to its posted hours. Reserve study rooms online. Library rules prohibit food in study rooms and restrict calls to designated areas.

cards.title: Take Notes onto Collier Patio
cards.subtitle: Outdoor workspace adjoining Buhl Library’s café
cards.notes: Use the patio for reading or laptop work in suitable weather, then move indoors before closing or whenever conditions threaten books and electronics.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor library-adjacent option for daylight study when weather and battery life cooperate.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Collier Patio as a named Henry Buhl Library space adjoining the café and describes the patio as available for student use.
cards.source_title: College rededicates library after $9 million renovation
cards.access_notes: Access is through the Buhl Library café area and follows library/building availability. Outdoor use is weather-dependent; verify the day’s library schedule.

cards.entity_name: Staley Hall of Arts and Letters
cards.title: Find a Nook in Staley Hall
cards.subtitle: Open spaces and study nooks across a three-floor academic building
cards.notes: Choose an open nook for individual or group work, connect through campus wireless, and check the floor-specific closing time before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A multi-floor academic setting offering both open areas and smaller nooks for study or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Staley Hall has numerous open spaces and nooks for studying or group work, with wireless access throughout the building.
cards.source_title: Staley Hall of Arts and Letters
cards.access_notes: Main-door hours are Monday–Thursday 7:30 a.m.–12:50 a.m., Friday 7:30 a.m.–6 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–noon with atrium card access only, and Sunday 5 p.m.–12:50 a.m. Upper floors close at 11 p.m.

cards.title: Work at the STEM Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Daylit collaborative tables with writable surfaces nearby
cards.notes: Bring a group problem set, use the shared tables and writable Walltalker surfaces, and carry your student card if working during evening access.
cards.short_summary: A bright science-building atrium designed around collaborative work, device use, and writable surfaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College documents an atrium lounge, common study spaces, shared-display workstations, and writable Walltalker surfaces in STEM Hall.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–6 p.m., except school holidays. Student-card access runs Monday–Thursday 6–11 p.m. and Sunday 7–11 p.m.; Sunday entry is through the doors facing Breen Student Union.

cards.title: Sketch Problems in Hoyt Hall
cards.subtitle: Engineering lobby tables with dry-erase boards
cards.notes: Use the tables and dry-erase boards to diagram a problem with classmates, then confirm building access locally before planning an evening session.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor engineering workspace built around tables, whiteboards, and collaborative problem-solving.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College describes Hoyt Hall’s first-floor lobby-study space as having modern tables, chairs, dry-erase boards, and a video monitor for collaborative work.
cards.source_title: Engineering aesthetics: Hoyt Hall gets a makeover
cards.access_notes: Located in Hoyt Hall’s first-floor lobby. The supporting page does not publish current building hours or reservation requirements; verify access on campus before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Lesson in Hamilton Library
cards.subtitle: Collaborative curriculum workspace inside Staley Hall
cards.notes: Bring a lesson-planning task and use the curated curriculum collection with classmates; confirm service availability with Education staff when needed.
cards.short_summary: A specialized collaborative library for education majors working with curriculum and lesson-planning materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College calls Hamilton Curriculum Library a collaborative hub for education majors to work together on effective lesson planning.
cards.access_notes: Located in Staley Hall. The College does not publish separate public hours for the curriculum library; follow Staley Hall access hours and confirm staffed services with the Education Department.

cards.title: Use Breen for an All-Hours Session
cards.subtitle: Lounging and study space in the campus student union
cards.notes: Choose Breen when you need a flexible communal setting, use a lounge or meeting area, and expect nearby dining, events, and conversation.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock, in-session student-union setting for study that does not require library-level quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College says Breen Student Union contains lounges and meeting places and provides spaces for lounging and studying.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week while classes are in session. It is a social student-union environment, so plan quiet or concentration-intensive work elsewhere.

warnings: Published access hours can change for holidays, academic breaks, and special events; verify same-day notices before relying on evening or weekend access.
The College’s public sources do not provide separately verified coordinates for interior rooms, so card coordinates are null.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Grove City’s Broad Street, Main Street, and College Avenue corridors, each paired with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Coffee on Broad Street
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — coffee and café drinks
cards.notes: Use this Broad Street stop for a café break; check the posted daily hours before heading downtown, especially on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown coffeehouse at 141 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The business identifies Beans on Broad at 141 S. Broad St. and publishes hours for every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: A Full Meal on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — sit-down dining
cards.notes: Choose this block when you want a sit-down meal, and consult the restaurant’s current menu and posted operating days first.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant destination at 131 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Broad Street Grille’s official site places the restaurant at 131 South Broad Street and describes its food service and menu.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists Tuesday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday and Monday are closed.

cards.title: Sushi on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — Japanese food
cards.notes: Head to this South Broad address for sushi or another listed menu item; use the official ordering page to plan pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Japanese restaurant stop at 138 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Jin Sushi’s official ordering page gives its location as 138 S. Broad St., Grove City, and provides online ordering.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official ordering page for current availability before traveling; no hours are stated on the cited page.

cards.title: House-Roasted Coffee Farther Down Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — roastery and café
cards.notes: Continue south on Broad Street for the Grove City roastery location; arrive before its posted afternoon closing time.
cards.short_summary: A coffee roastery and café at 221 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Collage Coffee identifies its Grove City roastery at 221 S. Broad St. and lists Monday–Saturday café hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday 7 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday closed.

cards.title: Browse Books on South Broad
cards.subtitle: Broad Street corridor — independent bookstore
cards.notes: Make this South Broad storefront your book-browsing stop; verify opening hours directly with the shop before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A brick-and-mortar bookstore at 251 South Broad Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Atlantic Independent Booksellers Association lists Bookends at 251 South Broad Street as a street-location bookstore carrying new and used books.
cards.source_title: Bookends Bookstore & Homeschool Resource Center, LLC
cards.access_notes: The cited booksellers-association listing does not publish current operating hours; contact the store before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Grove City Area Historical Society & Museum
cards.title: Local History on College Avenue
cards.subtitle: College Avenue corridor — community museum
cards.notes: Visit during the museum’s seasonal public window, and leave enough time to examine its Grove City history displays.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum housed at 111 College Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official contact page gives its address as 111 College Ave. and publishes seasonal museum hours.
cards.source_title: Contact Us - Grove City Area Historical Society & Museum
cards.access_notes: Open mid-April through mid-December: Monday 6–8 p.m. and Tuesday–Saturday noon–3 p.m.; the site currently also displays a seasonal-closure notice.

cards.title: Library Time on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — public library
cards.notes: Use this West Main stop for books or library services; match your visit to the day-specific schedule on its homepage.
cards.short_summary: The borough’s community library at 125 West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official homepage identifies Grove City Community Library at 125 W. Main Street and lists its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule varies by day and includes reduced summer Saturday hours from June 20 through August 29; Sunday is closed.

cards.title: Outdoor Recreation on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — community park
cards.notes: Enter from West Main Street for the walking trail, playground, courts, pond, or disc-golf course; follow posted park rules.
cards.short_summary: A municipal park with multiple outdoor recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City Borough states that Memorial Park’s main entrance is on West Main Street and documents its trail, playground, courts, pond, pavilions, and disc-golf course.
cards.access_notes: General park hours are not stated on the cited page. The pool is seasonal, has separate hours, and charges admission.

cards.title: Pizza on West Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — pizza shop
cards.notes: Use this West Main destination for pizza or another listed menu item; check the location page for that day’s closing time.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop at 604 West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Joe’s official Grove City location page lists the shop at 604 W. Main St. and provides its menu and daily hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 11 a.m. opening daily, 10 p.m. closing Friday–Saturday, and 9 p.m. closing other days.

cards.title: Bowling on East Main
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor — bowling and arcade
cards.notes: Follow Main Street east for bowling or arcade play; call ahead for lane availability, reservations, and current pricing.
cards.short_summary: A family entertainment center at 540 East Main Street Extension.
cards.evidence_claim: Bowl-O-Drome’s official page locates the venue at 540 East Main Street Extension and documents 20 bowling lanes, arcade entertainment, and a snack bar.
cards.access_notes: Current public hours are not stated on the cited page; call the official number before visiting or reserving a lane.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Grove City College rituals spanning opening ceremonies, Family Weekend performances, Homecoming pageantry, and Christmas observances.

cards.title: Begin the Year with Fanfare and Full Regalia
cards.subtitle: Harbison Chapel's formal welcome to a new academic year
cards.notes: Watch for the marching-band trumpet fanfare and the faculty procession that formally open Grove City's academic year.
cards.short_summary: A chapel ceremony welcomes the campus back with faculty regalia, music, scripture, prayer, and a presidential address.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College describes Opening Convocation as a tradition-steeped formal welcome featuring a trumpet fanfare and a procession of faculty in full regalia.
cards.source_title: Grove City College opens year with a call for community
cards.access_notes: A historical official account documents the recurring ceremony; consult the current campus calendar before attempting to attend.

cards.title: Sing the Alma Mater After the Senior Honors
cards.subtitle: A recognition ceremony established during the spring weekend tradition
cards.notes: Follow the printed program through academic awards, senior honors, the alma mater, and the post-ceremony reception.
cards.short_summary: Students gather in Harbison Chapel for a formal sequence of worship, academic honors, leadership awards, and the alma mater.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's official Recognition Convocation program includes academic awards, Senior Woman and Man of the Year honors, and the singing of the alma mater.
cards.access_notes: The cited program documents the ceremony's format; current attendance arrangements should be checked with the College.

cards.title: Turn Campus Groups into Song-and-Dance Crews
cards.subtitle: Family Weekend's friendly performance competition since 1957
cards.notes: Compare each Greek or housing group's coordinated singing and choreography, then stay for the competition results.
cards.short_summary: Campus organizations rehearse themed vocal-and-dance numbers for a long-running Family Weekend competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College's 2026 Family Weekend coverage identifies All-College Sing as a friendly song-and-dance competition between Greek and housing groups.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 performance was free, public, and livestreamed; verify the next Family Weekend schedule for future access.

cards.title: Stage the Spring Student Dance Show
cards.subtitle: A recurring Family Weekend performance in the PLC Arena
cards.notes: Choose a live performance or livestream and look for how the annual theme shapes student choreography and staging.
cards.short_summary: Student dancers build an annual themed production that opens before Family Weekend and returns for multiple performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's 2026 Family Weekend announcement documents the recurring Orchesis spring dance show, including its annual theme and three performances.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 shows were free and open to the public, with the Saturday performance livestreamed; future details may differ.

cards.title: Send Homecoming through Downtown Grove City
cards.subtitle: A campus-to-Carnegie procession of floats, bands, and alumni
cards.notes: Pick a public viewing point along Pine or South Broad Street and watch the campus procession move toward Carnegie Alumni Center.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming leaves campus as student floats, marching bands, alumni honorees, and community groups parade through town.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's 2024 Homecoming page says the parade travels from the Physical Learning Center along Pine and South Broad streets to Carnegie Alumni Center.
cards.source_title: Game on! Homecoming unites campus community
cards.access_notes: The 2024 parade was open to the public and livestreamed; verify the route and time in the current Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: Build a Float for Greek-Group Honors
cards.subtitle: Themed student floats compete before appearing in the parade
cards.notes: Spot how each Greek group interprets the year's theme, then catch the winning-float announcement before kickoff.
cards.short_summary: Local campus groups translate a shared theme into large parade floats and compete for Homecoming recognition.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College's 2024 Homecoming coverage states that Greek groups competed for honors with superhero-themed floats and that winners were recognized before the game.
cards.source_title: Game on! Homecoming unites campus community
cards.access_notes: Floats can be viewed during the public Homecoming parade; competition themes and recognition details change annually.

cards.title: Illuminate the Tower Star after a Campus Sing-Along
cards.subtitle: The Christmas season begins beneath Smith Hall's giant star
cards.notes: Gather on the MAP South patio for scripture, hymns, and prayer, then turn toward Smith Hall for the star lighting.
cards.short_summary: The campus opens its Christmas season by singing and praying together before illuminating the tower's giant star.
cards.evidence_claim: The official event page says GCC Light-Up Night brings students, employees, and community members together for scripture, hymns, prayer, and lighting the Smith Hall Tower Star.
cards.access_notes: The event page identifies MAP South Patio as the gathering point; confirm the next date and any weather changes.

cards.title: Pass Candlelight across Harbison Chapel
cards.subtitle: An annual Christmas service ending in shared candlelight
cards.notes: Attend one scheduled service and remain through the closing ritual as candlelight passes throughout Harbison Chapel.
cards.short_summary: Christmas liturgy, hymns, and music culminate as worshippers pass light from candle to candle across the chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College's 2025 Christmas announcement describes its annual Harbison Chapel service as culminating with candlelight passed throughout the chapel.
cards.source_title: A Grove City College Christmas: Music, cheer, and faith
cards.access_notes: The 2025 services were free and public; verify the next Christmas schedule and arrive early if seating guidance is posted.

cards.title: End the Ensemble Spectacle with a Mass Sing-Along
cards.subtitle: More than 150 student musicians converge for Christmas music
cards.notes: Listen for each ensemble's sound, then join the audience when the combined student groups close with a sing-along.
cards.short_summary: Choirs, bands, jazz players, and orchestra share one holiday production before joining the audience in song.
cards.evidence_claim: The College's 2025 announcement calls A Musical Christmas at GCC a newer tradition involving more than 150 students and ending with a combined-ensemble audience sing-along.
cards.source_title: A Grove City College Christmas: Music, cheer, and faith
cards.access_notes: The 2025 concerts were free and public in Ketler Auditorium; check the current music calendar for dates and seating details.

cards.title: Spend the Lunch Hour in a Colonnade Concert
cards.subtitle: Student ensembles perform across four December noons
cards.notes: Choose a noon program at Carnegie Alumni Center and use the rotating lineup to hear a different student ensemble.
cards.short_summary: A sequence of lunchtime concerts brings changing combinations of student singers and instrumentalists to the alumni center.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College's 2025 Christmas schedule documents four noon Carnegie Alumni Center concerts, each featuring a different lineup of student musicians.
cards.source_title: A Grove City College Christmas: Music, cheer, and faith
cards.access_notes: The 2025 concert series was free and public; consult the current Christmas schedule for the next lineup and dates.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Grove City College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence for learning Grove City College through its student hub, dining rooms, library, recreation spaces, arts facilities, and documented campus landmarks.

cards.title: Start at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon: find the campus information hub
cards.notes: Walk through the Great Room and GeDunk Commons, then scan the posted event notices and student-organization tables for weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Use the union to get oriented and identify activities happening while classes are in session.
cards.evidence_claim: Breen Student Union contains student-life offices, meeting and study spaces, the bookstore, mailroom, and GeDunk Commons, and it displays campus event notices.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, seven days a week while classes are in session; individual offices and vendors may keep separate hours.

cards.title: Settle In Over Friday Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: learn the main dining-hall routine
cards.notes: Check the live Parkhurst menu and dietary filters before arriving, then use dinner to compare schedules with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: Begin the weekend in one of the College's two full-service dining halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Hicks Café as a full-service dining hall and publishes weekday and weekend operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday–Friday and 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; verify menus and service details before visiting.

cards.title: Cross Between Upper and Lower Campus
cards.subtitle: Friday evening: trace the campus geography at Wolf Creek
cards.notes: Follow the marked route toward Wolf Creek, pause for a bridge photo, and use the crossing to understand how upper and lower campus connect.
cards.short_summary: A historic stone crossing makes the College's split-campus layout tangible.
cards.evidence_claim: Built in 1931, Rainbow Bridge spans Wolf Creek, connects upper and lower campus, and leads toward lower-campus destinations and downtown Grove City.
cards.access_notes: The history page does not state current access hours; obey posted route restrictions or temporary closure notices.

cards.title: Make a Saturday Library Loop
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning: locate research and writing support
cards.notes: Find the help desk and Writing Center, identify one quiet study area, and note where to return when your first assignment lands.
cards.short_summary: A short orientation lap turns the library into a usable academic base.
cards.evidence_claim: Henry Buhl Library provides print and digital research resources, one-on-one help-desk assistance, and a Writing Center for gathering, writing, and peer feedback.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are 8 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday hours are 2 p.m.–midnight. Academic services may keep narrower schedules.

cards.entity_name: Urban Trail Coffee Co. Outpost at Collier Café
cards.title: Pause at the Library Coffee Counter
cards.subtitle: Saturday late morning: take a break without leaving Buhl
cards.notes: Stop at Collier Café after the library loop, review the posted menu, and choose a table only after confirming the counter is serving.
cards.short_summary: The library's named coffee outpost provides a natural transition from study spaces to the afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies Urban Trail Coffee Co. Outpost in Collier Café inside Henry Buhl Library as serving coffee, drinks, smoothies, and baked goods.
cards.access_notes: The College dining page does not publish separate Outpost hours; confirm current counter hours before relying on this stop.

cards.title: Survey Your Recreation Options
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon: choose a future workout or game
cards.notes: Walk through approved student areas, locate the fitness and intramural facilities, and ask staff which spaces require reservations or orientation.
cards.short_summary: Use one visit to understand where indoor fitness, swimming, bowling, and court activities happen.
cards.evidence_claim: The Physical Learning Center houses student recreation facilities including pools, an intramural room and track, fitness center, bowling alley, and racquetball courts.
cards.access_notes: The facility page does not publish general weekend hours; students should verify access, eligibility, and equipment rules before participating.

cards.entity_name: J. Howard Pew Fine Arts Center
cards.title: See Where Campus Performances Happen
cards.subtitle: Saturday before noon: map the College's arts venues
cards.notes: Arrive during public Saturday hours, locate Ketler Auditorium and the recital spaces, and check official listings before planning a performance.
cards.short_summary: A daytime walkthrough introduces the main music and theater facility without assuming an event is scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Pew Fine Arts Center includes Ketler Auditorium, a black-box theater, recital and rehearsal halls, practice rooms, and music and theater facilities.
cards.access_notes: Saturday open hours are 7:20 a.m.–noon; noon–11 p.m. requires card access. Sunday access is restricted to eligible music students during stated rehearsal hours.

cards.title: Choose a Documented Saturday-Night Stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening: stay on campus for a late café window
cards.notes: Check the current menu before heading to MAP, bring your campus payment method, and treat the café as a flexible evening meetup point.
cards.short_summary: The Garage Café supplies a clearly documented, under-21-safe Saturday evening option on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garage Café is located in MAP, and Grove City College publishes Saturday service from 5 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Published Saturday hours are 5–11 p.m.; it is closed Friday and listed from 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday. Confirm current service before visiting.

cards.title: Build in a Quiet Sunday Pause
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning: visit a documented reflection space
cards.notes: Enter quietly, keep the room available for individual reflection, and use the pause to organize the coming week's priorities.
cards.short_summary: The chapel's prayer room offers a defined, campus-community space for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College states that the Harbison Chapel prayer room is available to any campus-community member for prayer and quiet reflection.
cards.access_notes: The prayer room is published as open daily from 6:30 a.m. to midnight for members of the campus community.

cards.title: Pick One Activity for the Weeks Ahead
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon: turn the weekend into a next step
cards.notes: Review the listed sports, choose one that fits your experience level, and contact Student Recreation for registration and schedule details.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by identifying a recurring activity that can connect recreation with campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College offers intramural activities across multiple skill levels, including team sports, racquet sports, bowling, table games, and esports.
cards.access_notes: Participation schedules, registration deadlines, locations, and eligibility vary; contact Student Recreation before attending or joining.
